tools: One type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument (choice)

features: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.summary: With no armor and no shield, AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Wis modifier.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.summary: Unarmed or with monk weapons (shortswords, simple melee weapons without two-handed/heavy) and no armor/shield: use Dex for attack and damage, use the Martial Arts die for damage, and make a bonus-action unarmed strike after attacking with the Attack action.

features.name: Ki
features.summary: Pool of ki points equal to the Ki Points column, regained on a short or long rest with 30 minutes of meditation. Ki save DC = 8 + prof + Wis. Grants Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind.

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.summary: Right after the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

features.name: Patient Defense
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to Dodge as a bonus action on your turn.

features.name: Step of the Wind
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to Disengage or Dash as a bonus action; jump distance doubles for the turn.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.summary: Speed bonus per the Unarmored Movement column while unarmored and without a shield. From 9th level, you can run up vertical surfaces and across liquids during your move.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.summary: Choose Way of the Open Hand, Way of Shadow or Way of the Four Elements; features at 3rd, 6th, 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.summary: Reaction when hit by a ranged weapon attack: reduce damage by 1d10 + Dex modifier + monk level. If reduced to 0 and you have a free hand, catch it and may spend 1 ki to throw it back as a monk-weapon attack with proficiency.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.summary: Reaction while falling: reduce fall damage by 5 x monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.summary: On a melee weapon hit, spend 1 ki: target makes a Con save or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.summary: Unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: On a Dex save for half damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.summary: Use your action to end one charmed or frightened effect on yourself.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.summary: Immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.summary: Understand all spoken languages, and any creature that knows a language understands your speech.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.summary: Proficiency in all saving throws; spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save and use the new result.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.summary: No frailty from old age, immune to magical aging, and no longer need food or water (can still die of old age).

features.name: Empty Body
features.summary: Action + 4 ki: invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage except force. 8 ki: cast astral projection without material components, on yourself only.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.summary: When you roll initiative with 0 ki remaining, regain 4 ki.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.summary: Flurry of Blows hits can impose one effect: Dex save or prone, Str save or pushed up to 15 ft, or no reactions until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.summary: Action: regain hit points equal to 3 x monk level. Once per long rest.

features.name: Tranquility
features.summary: At the end of each long rest, gain a sanctuary effect lasting until your next long rest (save DC 8 + Wis + prof); ends early as the spell does.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.summary: On an unarmed hit, spend 3 ki to plant vibrations lasting monk-level days; later use an action (same plane) to force a Con save: fail drops it to 0 HP, success deals 10d10 necrotic. One target at a time.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.summary: Action + 2 ki: cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence with no material components. Also learn the minor illusion cantrip if you lack it.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.summary: In dim light or darkness, bonus action to teleport up to 60 ft to another dim or dark space you can see; advantage on your first melee attack before the end of the turn.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.summary: In dim light or darkness, use your action to become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light.

features.name: Opportunist
features.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft is hit by someone else's attack: make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.summary: Know Elemental Attunement plus one other elemental discipline; learn one more at 6th, 11th and 17th level (may swap one each time). Discipline spells need no material components; from 5th level extra ki upcasts them, capped by the Spells and Ki Points table (3 ki at 5th-8th, 4 at 9th-12th, 5 at 13th-16th, 6 at 17th-20th).

choices.name: Elemental Attunement
choices.summary: Action: minor elemental tricks - harmless sensory effect, light/snuff a small flame, chill or warm up to 1 lb for 1 hour, or shape a 1-foot cube of earth, fire, water or mist for 1 minute.

choices.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
choices.summary: 1 ki when taking the Attack action: unarmed reach +10 ft for the turn and those hits deal fire damage; +1 ki on a hit for an extra 1d10 fire.
choices.prerequisite: 1 ki (+1 ki per hit for extra damage)

choices.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
choices.summary: Action + 2 ki: creature within 30 ft makes a Str save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki), is pushed up to 20 ft and knocked prone; half damage only on a success.

choices.name: Mist Stance
choices.summary: 4 ki: cast gaseous form on yourself.

choices.name: Shape the Flowing River
choices.summary: Action + 1 ki: reshape ice or water in a cube up to 30 ft on a side within 120 ft - freeze/thaw, raise or lower elevation, dig trenches, raise walls or pillars (changes up to half the largest dimension; can't trap or harm creatures).

choices.name: Water Whip
choices.summary: Bonus action + 2 ki: creature within 30 ft makes a Dex save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki) and is knocked prone or pulled up to 25 ft closer; half damage only on a success.

discrepancies: Way of Shadow subclass has no features in the app (features: []). Missing: Shadow Arts (3), Shadow Step (6), Cloak of Shadows (11), Opportunist (17).

Way of the Four Elements subclass has no features in the app (features: []). Missing: Disciple of the Elements (3, with new disciplines at 6/11/17), all 17 elemental disciplines with ki costs and level requirements, and the Spells and Ki Points cap table (3/4/5/6 max ki per spell at 5/9/13/17).
Monk tool proficiency missing: book grants one type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument; app proficiencies list only 'Simple Weapons', 'Shortswords'.
Feature name typo: app uses 'Ki Empowered Strikes' (progression level 6 and features list); book prints 'Ki-Empowered Strikes'.

Level 9 table entry: book prints 'Unarmored Movement improvement'; app progression lists 'Unarmored Movement' again and duplicates the whole Unarmored Movement feature at level 9 instead of marking it as an improvement (vertical surfaces / liquids).

Level 2 progression row in the app lists 'Flurry of Blows', 'Patient Defense', 'Step of the Wind' as table features; the book table shows only 'Ki, Unarmored Movement' (the three are sub-features of Ki). Harmless but not as printed.

No limited-use resource definitions: Ki points (= monk level from 2nd, short rest) exist only as progression.special.ki_points without recharge info; Open Hand's Wholeness of Body (1/long rest) has no resource.
Deflect Missiles app text appends 'which has a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet' (SRD/errata wording) not printed in this PHB.

Minor: level 1 Ki Points and Unarmored Movement are '—' in the book; app stores 0 (numerically equivalent). All other Martial Arts / Ki / Unarmored Movement values, hit die, saves, skills and Open Hand features match.
Monastic Tradition feature text in the app names only the Way of the Open Hand; book lists Open Hand, Shadow and Four Elements.
